label: Birthday
tagline: For a grown-up birthday, with memories from a whole life.
name: Birthday!

spaces.1: The house you were born in

chance.text: The party begins. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
There is cake waiting at {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The presents are at {11}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The music stops. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
Your train is running late. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You are late for the party. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You get a card with money inside.
You may ask the birthday guest for a favour. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You sing the birthday song in the wrong key. Go back three spaces.
You told everyone the birthday guest's age. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
The neighbours complain about the music. Pay {currency}30 per {house} and {currency}120 per {hotel}.
You forgot the present and buy flowers on the way.
You get a lift in {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
You buy a round for everyone. Pay each player {currency}40.
An old friend slips you an envelope.
The candles are ready at {39}. Go there.

chest.text: Hooray, another year older. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
The envelope with cards is packed full.
You drop the cake and a new one costs money.
You get the deposit back on all the bottles.
A good friend bails you out. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You gave away the surprise. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
You win the quiz about the birthday guest.
You find a note in your coat pocket.
It is your day. Each player gives you {currency}10.
Your colleagues chipped in for your present.
You break your aunt's vase. The new one is expensive.
You buy a present for the birthday guest.
You get your change back from the baker.
The party is over and everything needs cleaning. Pay {currency}35 per {house} and {currency}100 per {hotel}.
You find loose change between the sofa cushions.
You sell your old records at the jumble sale.

houseRules: The birthday guest may change one rule per round.
Whoever lands on {0} picks a song and everyone sings the first line.
Whoever buys a street shares a memory of the birthday guest.
